scope: Theorem 4.1 (Weighted parity gap) of the manuscript “The Unique Games Theorem” (preprints/The-Unique-Games-Theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 102 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 04d0290a9cb7ee81), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed rational ξ > 0, there is a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from Boolean satisfiability to weighted parity instances, with binary- encoded rational weights, such that YES: OPT(E) ≥ 1 − ξ, NO: OPT(E) ≤ 1 2 + ξ. The running-time polynomial may depend on ξ.
